name: DrySand
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.634

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven sand_01 (scuffed dry beach sand with small debris), 2x2, height-blended with a quarter-turned, shifted copy of itself under a 3 m mask so the 1.5 m scan period is broken; relief eased; graded to the original warm sand
known_weaknesses: one scan only: the same debris cluster appears a few times per tile in two orientations; no wind ripples
